The South Korean automaker wants to keep going by ramping up production at a new $7. 6 billion plant in Georgia to capture more sales and market share. " Hyundai also plans to add such vehicles, including a midsize pickup truck Since then, Hyundai executives said several transformations — from overhauling quality and design to logos and dealer showrooms — have led the brands to where they are today as quality value plays Kia Tasman Courtesy Kia "Both Kia and Hyundai are really good at being able to offer more in the vehicle than the consumer expects, and that they expect at that price point," said Stephanie Brinley, associate director of Mobility Global's AutoIntelligence He also said the global reach of Hyundai, which also owns steel plants and other suppliers, is paramount to its progress Hyundai on Wednesday said it is planning more than 100 vehicle launches and refreshes across Hyundai and Genesis by 2030, including 58 in North America. 이 기사는 해당 기업과 연결된 해외 보도를 바탕으로 정리했다.

matched_articles.title: Nexon Geochem validates Indian-origin raw materials for NdFeB permanent magnets
matched_articles.summary: Nexon 관련 기사다. 기사 제목은 'Nexon Geochem validates Indian-origin raw materials for NdFeB permanent magnets'이다. The company has technically validated the pathway to integrate domestic materials into its magnet manufacturing process, marking progress towards pilot production. This establishes the foundation for Nexon to build an integrated Indian supply chain for high-performance permanent magnets, from domestic feedstock to finished Nd-Fe-B magnets ” Nexon targets pilot production and customer validation Nexon plans to mobilise its offshore pilot for customer validation in India, work with customers on application-specific requirements, optimise the manufacturing process and product grades, and simultaneously advance the infrastructure, equipment and execution required for commercial-scale production The technical validation marks an important step in the technology transfer agreement between Nexon and Giredmet, as the programme progresses towards its next stage Evaluation covered raw materials and magnet performance As part of the programme, Nexon supplied Indian-origin Nd-Pr oxide, iron and ferroboron to Giredmet for technical evaluation In July 2026, Nexon Geochem signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) with Giredmet to jointly develop deep-processing technologies for rare-earth metal raw materials and NdFeB rare-earth permanent magnets. 이 기사는 해당 기업과 연결된 해외 보도를 바탕으로 정리했다.
